name: MarrOw: Summons
source:
A desperate witch summons a demon from Hell to save him from a mysterious cursed fate. But can he convince the demon to rescue him? And what will it take to do so? 

[From [url=https://loutellstales.itch.io/marrow-summons]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
绝望的女巫从地狱召唤恶魔来拯救他免受神秘的诅咒命运。但他能说服恶魔来救他吗？这样做需要什么？

[来自[url=https://loutellstales.itch.io/marrow-summons]Itch.io[/url]]
